To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a method that automatically synchronizes and calibrates RGBD and thermal streams, which is the first such method to our knowledge, and that it works well on a wide range of data.

we present a new method for automatically calibrating thermal cameras to RGBD cameras that uses invariant features visible by the two camera types, and that our method consistently converges to a correct calibration transform.

we present an automatic calibration method for RGBD and thermal sensors that uses only the edges visible in the two modalities and that we demonstrate that this method consistently finds the correct transform and generates high-quality RGBD and thermal data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatic calibration of thermal and RGBD cameras.
the problem of automatically calibrating RGB and thermal cameras in order to facilitate the creation of RGBDT data.
the calibration of RGBD-thermal cameras, which is a prerequisite for many thermal processing applications.

we propose a method for the calibration of RGBD-thermal camera systems that is automatic, robust, and applicable to arbitrary environments.
the method presented in this paper provides a novel and robust solution to the synchronization and calibration problem in RGBDT data.
the paper presents a method that automatically calibrates RGBD and thermal sensors in arbitrary environments.

we propose a method to calibrate RGBD and thermal camera in an arbitrary environment.
we have developed a method that can be used for the automatic calibration of RGBD/thermal camera pairs in arbitrary scenes.
we propose an automatic calibration method for RGBD and thermal streams.

RGBD and thermal streams can be synchronized and calibrated automatically, even in arbitrary environments, using only edges visible to both streams.
the combination of RGBD and RGBT data is feasible and that it can be done without the use of special calibration targets.
